closed_manuscript_claims.scope: Every finite characteristically simple nonsolvable group is an internal direct product of k>0 automorphic copies of one nonsolvable, explicitly nonabelian simple subgroup, and its exact order is |H|^k. This is the exact internal-direct-product encoding of N=S^k.

From the same characteristically-simple hypotheses, constructs a group isomorphism from G to the explicit coordinate-indexed external product setXn of copies of H over the finite factor index subtype, retaining the same simple nonsolvable and explicitly nonabelian H, the same positive factor count, the exact internal direct-product identity, and |G|=|H|^k. FORMAL-INTERFACE.json binds this exact existential coordinate isomorphism and positive base to the explicit MulEquiv/base input of the Lean ambient-wreath theorem.
